# triviaquiz.games

> Free interactive trivia quiz games on Bitcoin, board games, and more — available as Progressive Web Apps and on Android.

## Pages

- [Home](https://triviaquiz.games/): Hub listing all available trivia quiz topics with links to the PWA and Google Play store.
- [Community Questions](https://triviaquiz.games/community-questions/): Browse trivia questions submitted by the community, paginated and filterable by category.
- [Submit a Question](https://triviaquiz.games/submit/): Submit your own trivia question to be reviewed and added to the community pool.
- [Bitcoin Trivia Quiz PWA](https://bitcoin.triviaquiz.games): Interactive Bitcoin trivia quiz playable in the browser as a Progressive Web App.
- [Board Game Trivia Quiz PWA](https://boardgame.triviaquiz.games): Interactive board game trivia quiz playable in the browser as a Progressive Web App.

## Optional

- [Imprint / Impressum](https://triviaquiz.games/imprint.html): Legal notice in German (Impressum, required under German law).
- [Privacy Policy / Datenschutzerklärung](https://triviaquiz.games/privacy.html): Privacy policy in German and English (GDPR / DSGVO).
- [Sitemap](https://triviaquiz.games/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap for crawlers.
